item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 09/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will continue to bring heavy showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. With the trough of low pressure weakening, showers will lessen and the weather will improve slightly over the region early to midweek next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the coastal areas of southern China in the latter part of next week.

Date/Month: 10/09 (Sunday)
Wind: South to southeast force 4.
